source: PRD FR-38 (line 222, APH cl. 2.3.4 as cited) and the section 8 pipeline step 1 (line 133): "Ingest PDF / scan / DOCX; classify (EoA letter = master record, Format-2 NOC, Format-3 Resolution, lease, affidavit, other Annexure-2 item)".
human_review: Classification is a suggestion for a checker. It never changes the uploaded document's recorded type and never rejects or blocks an upload.
note: Phrase lists are prototype placeholders: the official Format-2 / Format-3 templates are not available yet (PRD section 19 asks whether they are), so a match on ordinary document names is evidence for review, not proof of what the document is.

classes.label: EoA letter
classes.declared_doc_types_note: Placeholder: no upload vocabulary defines an EoA-letter document type yet (FR-32 shows one to the institution; nothing uploads one).

classes.label: Format-2 NOC
classes.declared_doc_types_note: The Annexure-2 noc_format_2 line takes a university_noc upload (annexure_2.json).

classes.label: Format-3 Resolution
classes.declared_doc_types_note: The Annexure-2 resolution_format_3 line takes a format_3_resolution upload (annexure_2.json).

classes.label: Lease
classes.declared_doc_types_note: The Annexure-2 new_site_proof line takes lease_deed or lease_agreement (annexure_2.json).

classes.label: Affidavit
classes.declared_doc_types_note: The upload vocabulary's generic affidavit slot — the same placeholder mapping as RULE-DOC-01: numbered affidavits cannot be told apart here.

fallback.label: Other Annexure-2 item / unclassified
fallback.note: The PRD's catch-all: a document whose text matches no configured class is reported as unclassified with needs_review, never forced into one of the five.
